 Former Star Feels WWE Saw Liv Morgan’s First Title Win As A 'Lucky Loser' Thing
 Originally posted on
 SEScoops 
  | 
 By M Watson
  | 
 Last updated Nov 11, 2026 10:32 AM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 Liv Morgan’s first Women’s title win meant nothing to WWE, according to a former star.
 He is none other than her former Judgment Day cohort, Carlito. Speaking on the Hitting the Turnbuckle Podcast , the former WWE Intercontinental Champion said that the company thought that her first Women’s title win in 2022 was a lucky-loser kind of thing. He was referring to Morgan cashing in her Money in the Bank contract on Ronda Rousey to become champion.
  I remember too like when she won the the the the championship the first time was like she was like the what do you call it? The uh the lucky loser kind of thing, right?” 
 Moreover, Carlito went on to say that WWE didn’t believe that Liv Morgan belonged at the top of the women’s division. However, he was happy to see her prove them wrong.
 “Like she kind of won and then and now they you know I feel like the company didn’t believe in her. So you know I’m very proud of her that she you know she made them believe in her, you know what I mean?” 
 Liv Morgan has come a long way from where she started. She is indeed one of the top attractions of the women’s division. Moreover, The Miracle Kid is also the reigning WWE Women’s Champion. She is next set to defend her title against Becky Lynch at the upcoming WWE Survivor Series 2026 event. 
 So, it will be interesting to see if she continues to go on being at the top of her game.
